text_block_list.text: —It was a masterclass in entertainment.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki takes first place--!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Phew... haah...!

Thunderous applause and cheers
envelop Fuji Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Member A
text_block_list.text:
Lady Fujiiii~~! *sniff*!
You were even more gorgeous than ever~~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Member B
text_block_list.text:
I totally geddit~~! Like, you've somehow managed
to become even more insanely amazing~~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Everyone!
Thank you so much for watching the show!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Did you enjoy the race
that I took on with life-or-death determination?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Next up is finally the climax, the Arima Kinen!
A grand stage where a formidable 2,500m challenge awaits! Which means—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "My masterpiece will be my next work!"

Fuji Kiseki bowing gracefully
was projected across the giant monitor—

As the white dove took to the sky,
she vanished from the racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I grasped it, Trainer!

When Fuji Kiseki returned,
she wore a look of excitement unlike anything before.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What I want to show everyone—
what kind of scenery you see when you run carrying that weight!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yeah, thank you...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Next is finally the Arima Kinen, right?
2,500 meters is quite a formidable wall, but—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "That is precisely why it's surely the climax everyone is anticipating the most."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Conversely, failing here would lead to massive disappointment.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"‘Even Fuji Kiseki couldn't pull it off, after all.’
I can practically hear them saying it already."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you.
You're right... I've already made up my mind once.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I won't let it slip away.
I will reach it, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: To the brilliance of the greatest entertainer!

—Next is finally the Arima Kinen.
The climax, packed with countless wishes!
